summary_en: CE Holdings announced a tender offer to repurchase its own shares following the completion of SK-03's acquisition of 54.42% of the company. The company's board has authorized the self-tender offer as a follow-up to the third-party tender offer and share consolidation. Specific acquisition parameters including total amount, share count, and repurchase period are to be disclosed separately.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Own Shares and Public Tender Offer for Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
CE Holdings Co., Ltd. announced on November 13, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to conduct a public tender offer for its own shares. This decision was made following the completion of a third-party tender offer by SK-03 Co., Ltd., which resulted in SK-03 acquiring 54.42% of CE Holdings' outstanding shares (9,075,502 shares) as of September 29, 2026. The tender offer for own shares was also made contingent on the approval of a share consolidation by the company's extraordinary general meeting, which has now been obtained.

The third-party acquirer, SK-03 Co., Ltd., was established on June 9, 2026, as a special purpose vehicle for the acquisition of CE Holdings shares. SK-03 is owned by SK-02 Co., Ltd., which in turn is owned by SK-01 Co., Ltd., which is ultimately owned by investment funds managed by Japan Enterprise Growth Investment (Nihon Kigyou Seichou Toushi), a firm established in 2017 that specializes in providing investment-related services through the NIC Fund.

The specific parameters of the tender offer, including the maximum acquisition amount, number of shares to be repurchased, acquisition price limits, and the tender offer period, are to be disclosed separately. The self-tender offer represents a capital restructuring measure following the change of control transaction, with the company's board judging that all preconditions for proceeding with the repurchase have been satisfied.
